name: Shippo
summary: Multi-carrier shipping software for e-commerce. Compare rates, print discounted labels and automate tracking across carriers, with shipping that scales with your store.
best_for: e-commerce sellers shipping across multiple carriers who want rate comparison, label printing and tracking in one place with genuine rate discounts
skip_if: you ship a handful of packages monthly through one carrier (their native tools are fine), or you're big enough for direct carrier contracts to beat aggregated rates
honest_knock: The pricing is honest but layered. The free tier stops at 30 labels a month, and its 5¢ per label on your own carrier accounts quietly adds up. Pro looks like a flat $17 a month until you read the comparison table: it covers up to 10,000 shipments and then bills $0.08 for every label beyond that, so a good sales month adds a variable line to a subscription that reads as fixed. Address validation outside the US is metered too, at 9¢, 8¢ or 6¢ depending on plan. The real money is elsewhere anyway: in the carrier rate discounts, which vary by lane and weight. Run your five most common shipments through it against your current rates; that comparison decides, not the subscription price.

pricing.notes: Read on their own pricing page, re-verified 25 September 2026 and re-read on 27 November 2026, every amount the same. Starter is free: up to 30 labels a month, discounted USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express rates, 1 user login, and 5¢ per label if you connect your own carrier account. Pro is banded by monthly label volume, priced monthly or annually: 1-200 labels $19/mo or $205/yr; 201-500 $29 or $313; 501-1,000 $54 or $583; 1,001-2,500 $79 or $853; 2,501-5,000 $139 or $1,501; 5,001-10,000 $199 or $2,149. Annual billing saves about 10% at every band. Labels beyond 10,000 a month cost $0.08 each. Pro makes your own carrier accounts free and adds branded tracking, chat and phone support. Premier is contact-us: unlimited shipments, 15+ logins, a dedicated account manager. Non-US address validation is metered separately at 9¢, 8¢ and 6¢ per validation on Starter, Pro and Premier. API calls not tied to a Shippo label, and the Estimate API, bill at API Starter rates.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session compared carrier rates for one test parcel in Shippo on the free Starter plan. After I don't have a store and Buy your first label, only two zip codes and a package were needed, and the first rate overview came after about 3 minutes and 12 steps (the units were cm and kg by default). UPS Ground and UPS Ground Saver were $7.42 and USPS Ground Advantage $7.43, up to $81.22 for UPS Next Day Air Early. No FedEx or DHL Express rate appeared: the app said that the account is restricted from using this carrier, while the dossier promises USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express on Starter. The Buy label summary added Shippo Total Protection Insurance of $1.66, switched on automatically, to the $7.42 for a total of $9.08. A card was asked only at Start Pro free. The prices are unchanged against the dossier (Starter free with 30 labels, Pro $19 a month for 200 labels). Nothing was bought and the account was not closed. Account and start: the account was created by us and was signed in in his Chrome (the interface is in English); our AI assistant ran the test from 15:22 (Amsterdam). The dossier name is Shippo and the review is on OSM (osm/shippo-review.html). The audiences from the dossier: small online shops that ship a few parcels a month and suspect they overpay on postage, growing shops with 200 to 1,000 labels a month, and European stores that ship with DPD or PostNL (the dossier names Sendcloud as the alternative). Start: apps.goshippo.com/get-started asked What would you like to do first? with Connect my store and I don't have a store. I don't have a store was chosen, then Buy your first label (Compare carrier rates and purchase your first label in minutes). No store was connected. Core action: the screen Check rates asks only for zip codes (U.S. only): Ship from 80202, Ship to 78701, package Box 10 x 8 x 4 in, weight 1 lb. The units were cm and kg by default and had to be changed to in and lb. Time to the first rate overview: about 3 minutes and 12 steps, partly lost on the unit pickers. No address, name or card was needed. Rates (Shippo rates, Starter): UPS Ground $7.42, 2 days (Best and Cheapest); UPS Ground Saver $7.42, 3 days; USPS Ground Advantage $7.43, 5 days; USPS Priority Mail $11.50, 2 days; UPS 3 Day Select $12.70; UPS 2nd Day Air $12.75; UPS 2nd Day Air A.M. $19.49; UPS Next Day Air Saver $43.60 (Fastest); USPS Priority Mail Express $47.39; UPS Next Day Air $51.22; UPS Next Day Air Early $81.22. UPS Ground and USPS Ground Advantage are one cent apart. Carrier messages: Shippo: Your account is restricted from using this carrier. (no FedEx or DHL Express rates) and UPS: RatedShipmentAlert: Modifier is applied on Package(s);. Buy label: a click on the cheapest rate opens Buy label with a Sender and Recipient form (name, phone and e-mail of the sender, street and so on are required) and a Summary of UPS Ground $7.42 plus Shippo Total Protection Insurance $1.66 (Auto on, with Remove), Total $9.08. The button Buy label was not used and nothing was filled in. A comparison with our own current rate was not possible with a test parcel, so whether you overpay was not tested. Payment method: not asked when viewing rates and not when opening Buy label. It was asked at once at Start Pro free on Settings, Account, Plan: a dialog Add payment method (card or Google Pay), which was not filled in and was cancelled. Paying at Buy label itself was not tested. Plans: Settings, Account, Plan on 18 Nov 2026 in US dollars: Starter plan, Free, 30 labels/month, with the buttons Start Pro free and Manage plan. Manage plan: Try Pro free for 30 days, Free for 30 days, then billed based on your selected plan, Cancel anytime; slider 200 labels/month, Up to 5 users, $19 / Month (a switch for Month or Year); Premier is Contact Us. The other label bands and the yearly prices were not clicked through (the dossier lists $19 for 1-200 labels, $29, $54, $79, $139 and $199 by volume, monthly billing, and $205 a year for the first band). The Buy label screen for the cheapest rate showed Summary: UPS Ground $7.42 plus Shippo Total Protection Insurance $1.66 (Auto on, with a Remove link), Total $9.08; no tax line was seen; the button Buy label was not used and nothing was filled in. The public page goshippo.com/pricing was read again just before this delivery on the same day: Starter Free with up to 30 labels per month, 1 user login and the best USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express discounts; Pro 1-200 labels per month at $19/mo on the Monthly view and $17/mo with the Annual view (10% savings, $205 a year), up to 5 user logins and your own carrier account free; Premier Contact us; $0.08 per label beyond 10,000 labels a month. The prices are therefore UNCHANGED against the dossier. Deviation: the public page and the dossier promise discounted USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express rates on Starter, but in the test only USPS and UPS rates were shown; the app said Shippo: Your account is restricted from using this carrier. and no FedEx or DHL Express rate appeared. A second message was UPS: RatedShipmentAlert: Modifier is applied on Package(s);. Cancelling: Settings, Account, Plan has a red link Close account with the text When you close your account, you lose access to your historical shipping data and settings. It was not clicked. Cancelling Pro is under Manage plan (Cancel anytime) and was not tested, because there is no Pro. Not tested: buying or printing a label, the test API, connecting a store, FedEx and DHL Express rates (blocked for this account), the yearly price and tax, higher bands, Premier, the cancel flow of Pro and international rates. Clean up: nothing was created or bought, no payment method was added, the account stays on Starter and the tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The units start on cm and kg and cost steps. FedEx and DHL Express rates did not appear for this account, although the dossier promises them on Starter. The Buy label summary has an insurance of $1.66 already switched on, so the total is higher than the rate you picked unless you press Remove. A card is not asked when you look at rates, but the Pro trial asks for one at once. Closing the account loses your historical shipping data and settings.
